_doc: Defaults of a new GNN model card, applied when it is saved (model_store.save_model,
and the training repository). A saved GNN model card holds every value, so changing this
file changes the next networks, not the saved ones. Keys starting with '_' are comments.
"fit" (fitted on the training graphs: features.fit_normalisation), or per feature

_doc.channels: polarizations whose peaks the network uses
_doc.node_features: per antenna, in this order: names of features.NODE_FEATURES
_doc.graph_features: per event: names of features.GRAPH_FEATURES (the plane-wave vector), or []
_doc.delta_t_wave_speed: speed (m/s) of the plane wave for delta_t; null: c_light / n_atm
_doc.trigger: antennas whose peak > n_sigma * noise_rms_per_channel * sqrt(len(channels)) (106 ADC on x, y); an event needs min_antennas
_doc.knn_k: each antenna is linked to its knn_k nearest neighbors

architecture._doc: GNNScaleMDN: EdgeCNN, mean and max readout, a value head and a variance head
